title: Fine Is Not a Feeling
old_caption:
"Fine." can carry a lot: disappointed, missing them, not wanting to seem needy.
Name it without blame and leave the door open. A short true text lands softer than you think.

title: Forty-Two Unreads
old_caption:
Two weeks offline, forty-two unreads and one very worried voice note.
No essay needed. Sagittarius, who's waiting on your reply right now?

title: You Sent Your Crush an Agenda
old_caption:
Clear plans are a kindness. Texting your crush like a calendar invite is a choice.
Keep the plan, add why you want to go. Saturday sounds better with a little heart in it.

title: Facts, Not Feelings
old_caption:
They asked "do you like me?" and got a fact about octopuses. True fact, wrong answer.
Aquarius, what's your go-to dodge?

title: Six Sorrys
old_caption:
Five minutes late and six sorrys deep. Pisces, they were happy to wait.
One sorry, then a thank-you. It tells people they matter without you shrinking.

title: Neptune to Aries: The Two-Day Soulmate
old_caption:
Met them Tuesday, picking venues by Thursday. Neptune loves a whirlwind, but even the best films have a middle.
Which sign skips straight to the ending in your group chat?

title: Neptune to Taurus: The Memory Filter
old_caption:
Missing an ex can make the old photos glow pinker than they were. The good parts were real, and so were the reasons it ended.
Keep the warmth, not the plan to go back.

title: Neptune to Gemini: The Stranger on Platform 2
old_caption:
Gemini built a whole cottage life for a stranger in two train stops, dog included. Then said one word out loud.
Who else has a full daydream going on their commute?

title: Neptune to Cancer: Their Lines, Not Yours
old_caption:
If you've already written their rejection for them, that's your fear talking, not their answer. Ask kindly, then let them speak for themselves.
Save this for the next time you're scripting both sides.

title: Neptune to Leo: Not the Premiere
old_caption:
Leo expected a string quartet and a hot-air balloon. Got a picnic blanket and a really good sandwich. Honestly? Better.
What's the best small date you've been on?
